title: Separated affine and local charts surject onto the function field
statement: Let X be an integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] scheme [def-pc-scheme], let U=Spec(A) be a nonempty affine open subscheme of X, let x be a point of X\U, let B=O_{X,x} be its local ring, and assume B is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Let K=k(X) be the function field [def-sc-function-field]. Via the inclusions A\to K and B\to K [lem-sc-integral-scheme-stalks-in-function-field], the canonical ring map A \otimes B \to K is surjective.
